scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The Connection Lab
scenes.caption: A classroom mock-up advertises a digital art pack for two pretend tokens. Neel calls that the total price, but Tara reads the full schedule: two tokens for week one, then four tokens at the start of each later week while the pretend plan continues.
scenes.speech: A classroom mock-up advertises a digital art pack for two pretend tokens. Neel calls that the total price, but Tara reads the full schedule: two tokens for week one, then four tokens at the start of each later week while the pretend plan continues.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: What changed?
scenes.caption: The first advertised charge is not the same as the cost of a longer period. For four weeks, the schedule contains one introductory charge and three later charges. The team places each charge on a timeline so it does not accidentally count four introductory weeks or forget the repeated payments.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: All amounts and terms belong to this invented exercise, with no real subscription or purchase. The teacher changes the planned duration to six weeks, requiring a new total. Learners also identify unclear terms for adult review rather than assuming that a low first price explains every later obligation.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Decide and explain
scenes.caption: Schedule: week 1 costs 2 tokens; each later week costs 4 while the plan continues. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.speech: Schedule: week 1 costs 2 tokens; each later week costs 4 while the plan continues. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the consequence
scenes.caption: It states the introductory week’s charge, not the total for any longer duration. Read the full schedule and ask an adult to review unclear terms before a real commitment.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Investigate in the lab
scenes.caption: Investigate first and later prices, then count the full period, then change the duration. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
